rows: Emissions of air pollutants in the UK – Non-methane volatile organic compounds (NMVOCs)
Large group of organic compounds with similar atmospheric behaviour
Combustion, petrol vapour, solvents, cleaners and perfumes
React in sunlight to produce ground-level ozone
Ozone can trigger inflammation and asthma
Smoking, heating, cooking and candles can create hazardous compounds
Furniture, finishes, laminate flooring, cabinets and wood panels
NMVOCs can contribute to airborne particulate matter
